content.title: THE SNACK DRAWER FIX FOR {{BLOATING}} NOBODY TALKS ABOUT
facts: **Fennel seeds** – chew 1 tsp after a heavy meal, they relax gut muscles and ease trapped gas fast.
**Papaya** – contains papain, an enzyme that breaks down protein so it stops sitting heavy in your stomach.
**Peppermint tea** – 1 cup after eating calms the intestinal spasms behind that tight, swollen feeling.
**Cucumber** – high water content flushes out the extra sodium that makes you puff up overnight.
**Ginger slices** – steep 3-4 slices in hot water to speed up stomach emptying when you feel stuck and full.
**Asparagus** – acts as a natural diuretic, helping your body release water weight within hours.
**Plain yogurt** – 1 small bowl adds live cultures that quiet down gas-producing bacteria in your gut.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
If bloating hits you after almost every meal, a few kitchen staples can calm it down faster than you'd expect. Fennel seeds work because they relax the smooth muscle lining your gut, which lets trapped gas move through instead of sitting there pressing on your stomach. Papaya helps for a different reason: the papain enzyme it contains pre-digests protein, so your stomach doesn't have to work as hard after a heavy meal, which means less fermentation and less gas. Peppermint tea calms the spasms in your intestinal wall, the same spasms that create that tight, swollen feeling about an hour after eating. Everyone's gut reacts a little differently, so pay attention to which one actually settles yours.
